advice.text: Both axles lock under hard braking: brake pressure too high overall — bring it down to the knee.
advice.evidence: median deficit F 1.00 / R 0.68; 3/3 stops locked both

advice.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
advice.evidence: 3/5 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

advice.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
advice.evidence: median peak rear slip 14.96; 3/3 launches spun

advice.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Rear-limited corners: rear ARB/springs softer; on throttle (phase 4) accel diff lock -10%.
advice.evidence: 2/5 corners red on the rears (0 on exit)

advice.text: Suspension hits full compression at speed: ride height up a notch or springs stiffer (verify on the HUD Suspension page).
advice.evidence: 349 bottoming frames above 40 mph (detector still coarse)

advice.text: Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
advice.evidence: USI median +0.305 over 5 corners (3 understeer, 0 mid-corner front reds)

advice.text: Mixed axle signal — 3 front-limited vs 2 rear-limited of 5 corners. Not enough agreement for a balance call: repeat the same corner type several times before changing anything.
Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.40) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
